equity_bridge.item: Non-controlling interests (deducted once; flows are total-Group)
equity_bridge.note: 30 June 2026 condensed consolidated balance sheet; NCI share of FY2025 profit RMB28.4m (2.1%).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Year-1 anchored to FY2026 run-rate: H1 FY2026 revenue +8.0%, Q2 2026 trading update mid-to-high single-digit core-brand retail sales growth; decelerates toward the 3% terminal rate. Equity 5-year CAGR (8.8%) is the conservative cross-check and lands at the same level.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (8.8% 5yr) is ~48% below revenue CAGR (16.8%) and ~66% below EPS CAGR (25.8%). Cause is capital return, not weak profitability: dividends resumed in FY2023 and the payout ratio has been 45% since FY2024 (RMB580m FY2024, RMB584m FY2025), so book value compounds at roughly ROE x 55%. Not a red flag for growth selection, but it means the equity CAGR understates the earnings power.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 -90.9, FY2021 253.5, FY2022 222.8, FY2023 260.3, FY2024 -253.2, FY2025 518.3 (RMB m). The 3-year owner-FCF CAGR (32.5%, FY2022->FY2025) is from a low base and the series is dominated by working-capital swings; the 5-year CAGR is undefined because FY2020 owner FCF was negative. SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs differ only by the FY2022 RMB43.6m SBC and the declining interest income; SBC has been zero since FY2023 so there is no SBC-outgrowing-cash-flow issue. Growth selection leans on revenue guidance and the equity CAGR rather than the FCF series.

exit_multiple_cap_ev_ebitda.basis: research-stock Step 8c.5 item 4: terminal value = min(Gordon, cap x terminal EBITDA), cap per scenario from the stock's own 10-year FY-end EV/EBITDA range as printed by scripts/sanity_check.py (bear = 10yr min, base = 10yr average 2.30x, bull = 10yr maximum 5.36x). The 10yr minimum is -1.56x (FY2020: market cap below net cash) and two of eight year-ends were negative, so the bear cap is floored at 1.0x, just above the lowest positive year-end (0.88x, FY2018) -- a negative multiple is a statement about the cash, not a going-concern terminal value.
exit_multiple_cap_ev_ebitda.translation: The engine's terminal_cap_multiple is in owner-FCF terms (TV = cap x year-10 FCF). Each EV/EBITDA cap is converted with that scenario's year-10 EBITDA / FCF ratio from the pre-fix build (flows are unchanged by the fix): base 2.3 x 3265.7/2070.0 = 3.6x FCF; bull 5.4 x 3934.5/2557.8 = 8.3x FCF; bear 1.0 x 1845.0/1080.0 = 1.7x FCF.
exit_multiple_cap_ev_ebitda.caveat: sanity_check.py's historical table applies inputs.fx_rate in the quote->reporting direction while the repo stores it reporting->quote (see memory: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-systemic-bug), so its printed history is overstated by fx^2 = 1.375x; on a consistent RMB basis the 10yr average is ~1.7x and the maximum ~3.9x. The printed (more generous) figures were used as instructed; the correctly-converted ones would cut the terminal further, not restore it.

scenario_narratives.base: 361 Degrees keeps growing at the mid-to-high single digits its Q2 2026 trading update describes: mainland offline is flat-to-low-single-digit, e-commerce (29.5% of FY2025 revenue, +26%) and the Kids line do the heavy lifting, and overseas adds a point or two of group growth from a small base. EBITDA margin drifts from 17.0% to 17.5%; the sponsorship calendar and 3-4% R&D intensity cap further expansion. Working capital stops lengthening but does not reverse, absorbing ~35% of each year's revenue increase. Capex eases from the FY2024-25 plant-purchase spike toward 1.5% of revenue. The 45% payout continues, funded comfortably from FCF of ~RMB1.0-1.1bn in year 1 rising toward RMB2bn by year 10. After the sanity-check fix the flows are discounted at 11.5% and the year-10 business is exited at 2.3x EBITDA, the stock's own decade-average multiple: no re-rating is assumed.
scenario_narratives.bull: The international business (+80% overseas retail sales, +140% cross-border e-commerce in H1 2026, HK$488m of placement proceeds earmarked) and instant-retail integrations compound at double digits for several years, Super Premium Stores (127 -> 188 in six months) raise store productivity, and Kids rides pro-natalist/school-sports policy. E-commerce mix passes 35%, lifting EBITDA margin to 18.5%. Working-capital days normalise toward FY2022 levels, so growth consumes only ~25% of incremental revenue and FCF converts closer to net profit. Profit growth continues to lead the big-four domestic brands. The exit is capped at 5.4x EBITDA, the decade high -- the bull re-rates to the top of its own range, not to ANTA's.
scenario_narratives.bear: The FY2021-25 working-capital trend (days 114 -> 192; receivables and distributor deposits up RMB1bn in FY2025 alone) turns out to have been channel stuffing: distributors destock through FY2027-28, revenue goes flat then down, discounting takes EBITDA margin to 14%, and ECL provisions on trade receivables (already RMB341m, 6.8%) rise. ANTA, Li Ning and Xtep push harder into the value tier. The overseas expansion absorbs the placement cash without reaching scale. Growth recovers only to 2% and the terminal multiple is ~1x EBITDA -- the market never re-rates a chairman-controlled HK-listed Chinese small cap whose RMB4.7bn of cash earns 0.25%, and at times (FY2019-20) has valued the business at less than that cash.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in RMB, converted to HKD at the spot CNY/HKD rate, with RMB4.7bn of net cash taken at face value and added once in the bridge (interest income stripped from the flows), NCI deducted once, SBC zero so house and street coincide. SANITY-CHECK FIX (2026-10-16): the first build (9.5% RMB cost of equity, 15x/15x/12x FCF terminal caps) gave a weighted IV of HK$13.41 and tripped all four multiples rules -- implied P/E 22.4x vs a 10-year average of 11.1x, P/B 2.90x vs a 10-year maximum of 1.56x, EV/EBITDA 13.4x vs a maximum of 5.4x, and 189% base upside with the price already at 89% of its 10-year range. The diagnosis was WACC too low for structural risk. Two composable fixes from the research-stock template were applied and nothing else was touched: (1) WACC 9.5% -> 11.5%, adding +1.0% for extreme cyclicality (the 2011-13 Chinese sportswear channel collapse) and +1.0% for single-brand/single-country/distributor-channel concentration -- no small-cap illiquidity premium because the US$1.36bn market cap is above the template's threshold; (2) an EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap anchored to the stock's own 10-year FY-end range: bear 1.0x (floored; the true minimum is negative), base 2.3x (decade average), bull 5.4x (decade maximum), translated into the engine's FCF-multiple cap as 1.7x/3.6x/8.3x. Growth, margin, capex, tax and working-capital paths and the 25/50/25 weights are exactly as before. What the cap means: the first build's gap to the price was the re-rating thesis -- a 15x terminal says a buyer in year 10 pays a normal consumer-brand multiple for this business. The decade of trading history says the HK market pays ~2x EBITDA for it ex-cash and has twice priced it below its cash. The capped DCF now assumes that discount is permanent, which is the conservative reading of a chairman-controlled company whose cash earns 0.25% and whose working capital has absorbed three-quarters of its revenue growth. INVESTMENT FRAMING: this is no longer a multi-bagger re-rating story. It is income plus modest growth -- a 45% payout (~6.5% yield at the valuation-date price on FY2025 earnings), mid-single-digit revenue growth, and a free option on a re-rating that the model deliberately does not pay for. The actionable number is the 15%-hurdle weighted entry price; the upside to the capped weighted IV is the margin of safety on the no-re-rate case, not the prize.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working capital: FY2024-25 outflows consumed 71-79% of the revenue increase; if receivable/inventory days keep lengthening the base case overstates FCF by several hundred RMB m a year, and a destocking cycle (bear) takes revenue negative.

Cash authenticity and use: RMB4.7bn of net cash earned RMB11m in FY2025 (~0.25%) after fixed deposits were uplifted in FY2024; the model takes it at face value and adds it to equity. The market plainly does not; at the valuation-date price net cash is ~45% of market cap.
Governance: chairman-controlled; the May 2026 top-up placement/subscription was with a Ding-family trust vehicle; prior-decade distributor clean-up and bond buy-back history.
Currency: flows in RMB, quote in HKD; the fx_rate is spot and is not refreshed by price-only updates. A 5% CNY move is ~5% of every HKD per-share value.
Competition and consumption: ANTA/Li Ning scale, Xtep in the same tier, lower-tier-city discretionary demand sensitive to PRC consumer confidence and US-China trade sentiment.

Exit-multiple cap: the terminal is now pinned to the stock's own depressed trading history (2.3x EBITDA base), so the value is insensitive to terminal growth but moves roughly one-for-one with the cap. If the market ever does re-rate the business toward sector multiples the capped DCF is far too low; if the historical table were corrected for the sanity_check fx-direction bug the caps would be ~27% lower still.
Double-charging: the +2.0% WACC premium and the 25% bear weight both price cyclicality and governance; the result is deliberately conservative rather than exactly once-charged.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fix_applied: 2026-10-16 fix pass (research-stock Step 8c.5, one pass). Trip: P/E 22.4x > 2x 10yr avg 11.1x; P/B 2.90x > 1.5x 10yr max 1.56x; EV/EBITDA 13.4x > 1.5x 10yr max 5.4x; base upside 189% with price at 89% of 10yr range. Diagnosis wacc_too_low (cyclicality). Fixes applied, composable, in template priority order: (2) WACC premiums -- 9.5% -> 11.5% in all scenarios (+1.0% extreme cyclicality, +1.0% concentration; no illiquidity premium, market cap > US$300m) -- and (4) EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap per scenario from the stock's 10yr FY-end range as printed by the check (bear 10yr min floored at 1.0x because the true min is -1.56x; base 10yr avg 2.3x; bull 10yr max 5.4x), implemented through the engine's FCF-terms terminal_cap_multiple as 1.7x/3.6x/8.3x (was 12x/15x/15x). Not applied: mid-cycle FCF (FY2025 owner FCF is below mid-cycle because of the RMB759m working-capital outflow, not above it) and a growth cap (year-1 growth 8% is already half the 16.8% through-cycle revenue CAGR). Driver paths, weights and SBC (zero) untouched. Binding bound was EV/EBITDA: on the script's basis (base IV in HKD against RMB fundamentals, uncorrected for the fx-direction bug) the base IV had to fall below ~HK$9.33.

implied_multiples_after_fix.basis_note: Two bases. 'script_basis' reproduces scripts/sanity_check.py arithmetic (base-case intrinsic_value in HKD divided by RMB per-share fundamentals, history converted price*fx), which is what the pass/fail is graded on. 'rmb_basis' divides the RMB intrinsic value (HKD / 1.1727) by the same fundamentals and divides the printed history by fx^2 = 1.375 -- the consistent-currency comparison. Bounds: P/E <= 2x avg, P/B and EV/EBITDA <= 1.5x max, base upside <= 100% when price is in the upper half of its 10yr range.

rmb_basis.note: On the consistent basis the base case still sits above the corrected 10yr P/B maximum (1.45x vs 1.13x) and at 1.4x the corrected EV/EBITDA maximum, i.e. inside the 1.5x tolerance; it passes the same rules by a narrower margin.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 1361.HK at inputs.price_as_of (regular close, HKD); 52-week range 3.95-7.25.
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at inputs.fx_note date.
data_sources.financials: 1361.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2018-FY2025 annual + H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026); FY2025 annual report (cash-flow statement incl. working-capital block, Note 4 interest income, Note 6 tax, five-year summary turnover days); H1 FY2026 interim report (30 June 2026 balance sheet, net-cash table, Note 7 EPS/share count, Note 13 bank loans, cash-flow statement).
data_sources.qualitative: 1361.HK_Analysis.json (business model, growth drivers, risks, H1 2026 and Q2 2026 trading commentary, May 2026 placement).

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,167,682,000 ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim report, share capital note, after the May 2026 100m-share top-up subscription). Diluted = basic: Note 7(b) states no dilutive potential shares outstanding; share options lapsed in FY2023. Held FLAT: SBC is zero and no further non-SBC issuance is announced; the May 2026 placement is already in the count and its RMB531.9m proceeds are already in the 30 June cash balance.
inputs.total_debt_note: Bank loans RMB460.806m (all current, fixed-rate, unsecured) + lease liabilities RMB18.444m (12.005 current + 6.439 non-current), 30 June 2026 condensed balance sheet.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents RMB5,180.505m + pledged bank deposits RMB9.105m (performance guarantees), 30 June 2026. Company's own 'net cash' line is RMB4,728.8m before leases. Interest income on this pile was only RMB11.1m in FY2025 (~0.25% yield) because the RMB1.6bn of >3-month fixed deposits was uplifted in FY2024 and the balance sits in demand deposits; taken at face value but listed as a key risk.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 operating cash flow RMB814.615m less PP&E payments RMB285.219m (business acquisition of RMB94.5m for OEM plant/patents treated as M&A, not maintenance capex). FY2025 owner FCF is depressed by a RMB759m working-capital outflow; FY2024 reported FCF was -RMB198.9m on a RMB1,308m outflow. H1 FY2026 owner FCF was RMB590.4m with working capital turning positive.
inputs.sbc_source: Zero. FY2023 AR Note 30: equity-settled share-based payment nil (FY2022: RMB33.2m); FY2024 and FY2025 cash-flow statements carry no SBC add-back; H1 FY2026 Note 7(b): no dilutive potential shares. EquityAwardTaxes nil throughout.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 Note 4 interest income on financial assets at amortised cost RMB11.1m (FY2024: 54.4m; FY2023: 83.6m). Stripped because net cash (RMB4.7bn) is ~9x the owner-FCF base; the cash is added back in the bridge.
inputs.buyback_note: No share repurchases in any year FY2018-H1 FY2026. The flat count is a modelling convention, not funded by buybacks; with SBC at zero there is no grant dilution to offset, so no buyback is needed to hold it flat.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. All per-share values computed in RMB and converted at CNY/HKD 1.1727 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T10:09Z). No dual listing for a parity check; cross-check instead on the FY2025 dividend: 45% of RMB0.633 EPS = RMB0.285/share, declared as HK31.7 cents, implying ~1.11 CNY/HKD at the March 2026 declaration date, consistent with the rate's level and direction (CNY has since strengthened). Unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD; the *_cny twins carry the RMB basis.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB, the currency of the flows. Standard component: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x 7.0% equity risk premium (mature-market 4.5% + China country risk ~2.5%) = 9.5% cost of equity; gearing is ~2-3% of assets so WACC = cost of equity. SANITY-CHECK PREMIUMS (added 2026-10-16 after the multiples check tripped with diagnosis wacc_too_low, per research-stock Step 8c.5 template): (1) extreme cyclicality +1.0% -- low end of the 1.0-2.0% row because the in-window EBITDA range is only 2.1x (RMB906m FY2018 -> 1,893m FY2025); the >3x peak-to-trough evidence is the 2011-13 Chinese sportswear channel-inventory collapse, in which 361 Degrees' own profit fell by more than 80% and it needed a distributor clean-up; (2) concentration +1.0% -- mid of the 0.5-1.5% row: one brand, one country, PRC lower-tier-city consumption, sold through a distributor-wholesale channel whose inventory the company does not control; (3) small-cap illiquidity NOT added: market cap ~HK$10.6bn (~US$1.36bn) is well above the template's US$300m threshold, and the HK-listed-Chinese-small-cap governance discount is carried in the scenario flows and the 25% bear weight, not stacked here. Total 11.5%, same in all three scenarios. Note this partially double-charges risk already in the bear weight; the weights were deliberately left at 25/50/25 because they are a prior judgment and the sanity check showed the weighting alone left the valuation outside its own 10-year multiple range.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB18.4m included in total_debt; lease principal (RMB6.3m FY2025) NOT deducted from flows; right-of-use depreciation (RMB9.0m) sits inside D&A. Leases are immaterial (<0.2% of EV) because the Group sells through distributors rather than owned stores.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests of RMB481.969m (30 June 2026) deducted via equity_bridge. Flows are therefore modelled on a total-Group basis. Calibration: FY2025 EBIT 1,767.1 x (1 - 23.9%) = RMB1,345m vs reported total net profit RMB1,337m (attributable 1,308.9 + NCI 28.4) -- ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, probability-weighted (dcf-methods routing: non-US operating company -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). Fresh build, first valuation of this ticker; SANITY-CHECK FIX PASS applied the same day (see sanity_check.fix_applied and valuation_philosophy). 361 Degrees is an ordinary operating company (PRC mass-market sportswear, distributor wholesale + e-commerce), not a bank/REIT/LIC. Adaptations applied: (a) RMB flows vs HKD quote, WACC built in RMB; (b) leases as debt; (c) NCI deducted once in the bridge; (d) interest income stripped and cash added in the bridge; (e) SBC-zero market -- SBC rows kept explicit at 0%, house and street coincide, band_position null; (f) risk charged in the scenario flows and weights, plus, after the sanity-check trip, +2.0% of explicit WACC premiums and an EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap anchored to the stock's own 10-year trading range. The single most important driver is working capital: FY2024 and FY2025 working-capital outflows consumed 79% and 71% of the respective revenue increases (working-capital days 114 -> 192 over FY2021-25, trade receivables up RMB390m and other receivables/deposits up RMB627m in FY2025 alone), so wc_capture_pct is NEGATIVE in every scenario -- growth consumes cash in this distributor model. FY0 is FY2025 (31 Dec); year 1 is FY2026, of which H1 is reported (+8.0% revenue, +8.0% attributable profit). Capex: FY2024-25 spiked to ~2.6% of revenue (OEM plant purchase, new production capacity) from <1% historically; projected at 2.2% easing to 1.5%. The stock trades at ~6.9x FY2025 earnings and ~2.3x EV/EBITDA with 45% of market cap in net cash; the un-capped DCF at a 9.5% RMB discount rate sat 2.9x above a price that embeds a chronic HK-listed-Chinese-small-cap discount, which is what the exit-multiple cap now encodes (see valuation_philosophy).

bear.terminal_rationale: 1.7x owner-FCF cap = 1.0x year-10 EBITDA, the floored 10-year-minimum FY-end EV/EBITDA (the actual minimum is negative; the lowest positive year-end was 0.88x in FY2018). Was 12x FCF. In the bear the market again prices the operating business at roughly nothing beyond its cash, as it did in FY2019-20.
bear.narrative: Channel inventory build unwinds: distributor destocking and discounting in FY2027-28 as lower-tier-city consumption stalls; ANTA/Li Ning/Xtep price into the value tier; receivable days keep lengthening and ECL provisions rise; the overseas push absorbs the placement cash without reaching scale. Terminal at ~1x EBITDA reflects a market that, as in FY2019-20, values a chairman-controlled HK-listed Chinese small cap at little more than its cash.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 at the H1 run-rate (+8.0%); e-commerce (+26% FY2025) and overseas (+80% retail, +140% cross-border H1 2026) offset a mature mainland offline channel growing low single digits; fades to 3% nominal RMB terminal. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA margin 17.0% (operating margin 15.9%, within the 15.4-18.3% FY2021-25 range). Modest 50bp expansion from e-commerce mix and scale, held back by the sponsorship calendar (Winter Olympics, World Cup, Asian Games) and R&D guided to 3-4% of revenue. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix.
base.wc_rationale: Steady-state working capital (net trade receivables ~4.7bn + inventories 2.0bn - trade and other payables 2.7bn) is ~35% of revenue, so holding days flat consumes 35% of each year's revenue increase. FY2024-25 ran at 71-79% as days lengthened; base assumes the lengthening stops (H1 2026 inventory days fell 117 -> 102) but does not reverse. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix.
base.capex_rationale: FY2024-25 capex of RMB269m/285m (2.6%) funded new in-house production capacity; H1 2026 was only RMB15m. Eases from 2.2% to 1.5%, above the <1% of FY2018-23 to fund the vertical-integration strategy; D&A rises from 1.1% toward 1.3% as the new plant depreciates. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix.
base.tax_rationale: FY2025 effective rate 23.9% (23.7% FY2023-24); PRC statutory 25% with some preferential rates, plus withholding on dividends up to the HK parent. Cash tax paid was 87% of expense in FY2025; 24% flat on EBIT. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix.
base.wacc_rationale: 11.5% = 9.5% standard RMB cost of equity + 1.0% cyclicality + 1.0% concentration (was 9.5% before the 2026-10-16 sanity-check fix; see inputs.wacc_rationale).
base.terminal_rationale: 3.6x owner-FCF cap = 2.3x year-10 EBITDA, the stock's 10-year average FY-end EV/EBITDA (was 15x FCF; Gordon at 11.5%/3.0% would be 12.1x, so the cap binds hard). This is the no-re-rate assumption made explicit: the terminal buyer pays what the HK market has on average paid for this operating business ex-cash over the last decade.

bull.terminal_rationale: 8.3x owner-FCF cap = 5.4x year-10 EBITDA, the stock's 10-year maximum FY-end EV/EBITDA (FY2025). Was 15x FCF. The bull's re-rating is capped at the best multiple the market has actually paid, not a Western peer multiple.
bull.narrative: Overseas and e-commerce compound; Kids and Super Premium Stores lift productivity; working-capital days normalise toward 2022 levels so growth consumes less cash; margin reaches 18.5% as e-commerce mix passes 35%. Operating flows unchanged by the sanity-check fix; discounted at 11.5% and exited at the 10-year-high multiple.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 3.6x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the rising working-capital days are the classic precursor of a Chinese sportswear channel-inventory correction (the industry went through exactly this in 2012-14, and 361 Degrees itself needed a distributor clean-up then), the cash pile yields only 0.25%, and the May 2026 placement was with a chairman-family vehicle. Bull cut to 25% because it needs three independent things -- overseas scale, working-capital normalisation and margin expansion -- to land together. Base 50%. UNCHANGED by the sanity-check fix, even though the WACC premiums now partly overlap with the bear weight: the weights are the prior judgment and the fix was told to act on WACC and the exit multiple.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.
